segments.text: My name is Abraham Aguirre and I'm a board certified occupational therapy practitioner.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And I'm here because I have experience on COVID units.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I've worked on three COVID units, two isolation COVID unit, and one step down unit.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And so I've witnessed a lot of what I guess the media has been talking about, and I see how they've misrepresented the truth on COVID, the truth on the testing.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: For instance, at my facility, I work at the biggest skilled nursing facility here in Oahu, and I work with the geriatric population
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The people that were moved to the COVID unit didn't have COVID.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They tested positive with the PCR test, but most of them were asymptomatic and only suffering from their pre-existing conditions.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: None of them had exacerbated symptoms.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Most of them weren't sick other than what they were already dealing with, end-stage renal failure, diabetes, COPD, congestive heart failure, things of that nature.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I also saw how some of the hospice patients that were moved to the COVID units that died of terminal illness were actually
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: put on the COVID death list, which is complete fraud.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And facilities were facilitating this and doing this the whole time.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: More people survived and had no issues and were asymptomatic that were well into their 80s and 90s than that passed away.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My entire experience on these COVID units, I think there were 12 deaths and none of those deaths could fully be attributed to COVID.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: It was all pre-existing conditions of terminal illness.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
